description: Hi, i am a single-person team working with only myself. I love drawing, animation, and many other artistic hobbies. I am a very passionate and confident person when it comes to my interests.
summary: my project consists of an animation of the humanifications of mars and the moon. It consists of 3 characters. Dina, Mars, and Luna (humanification of the moon). Dina will introduce her friends to you (mars and the moon). I depict my storytelling like this because people prefer more colorful, infographic, and simple animations rather then reading a long and complicated to understand description of something. Not only that, kids and teenagers refuse to read something that seems too long for them. so, thats why i created an animation of summaries about the equipment discarded by Nasa on the moon and mars.
details: It is an animation for people (target audience of teenagers and kids) to watch. My goal is to get kids to learn about space while enjoying a visual-novel inspired animation. The benefits it has is for kids to learn about space while also getting to enjoy the animation like it is a cartoon show, for this animation i used Ibispaint and Alight Motion. My project is creative because it consists of humanized designs of the moon and mars. I considered to animate because i have not yet learnt the skills of coding.
